_meta.purpose: Four reports inserted at migration time so the Community Reports section is never empty. They carry seed = 1 and public = 1, and they describe message shapes the engine already models — the same families as content/threats.json.
_meta.rule: No names, no numbers, no institutions, no contact details. A seeded report reads exactly like a real anonymous one, because a real anonymous one holds nothing else either.
_meta.language: Each seed carries a key and both languages. The database row keeps its English description — it is what migration 0002 inserted and what the row has always been — and seed_key is what the app renders from, in the reader's language. A real anonymous report has no key and renders its own words, in whatever language they were written.

description.en: Got an SMS saying I had an unpaid fine and had 24 hours to settle it through a link. The link was not on a government domain.
description.ar: وصلتني رسالة نصية تقول إن عليّ مخالفة غير مدفوعة وأمامي 24 ساعة لتسديدها عبر رابط. الرابط لم يكن على نطاق حكومي.

description.en: A work-from-home offer on WhatsApp, good salary, no interview, then they asked for a registration fee before anything started.
description.ar: عرض عمل من البيت عبر واتساب، براتب جيد وبلا مقابلة، ثم طلبوا رسوم تسجيل قبل أن يبدأ أي شيء.

description.en: Someone called saying they were the bank's fraud department and asked me to read out the code that had just arrived on my phone.
description.ar: اتصل بي شخص قال إنه من قسم مكافحة الاحتيال في البنك وطلب مني أن أقرأ له الرمز الذي وصل للتو على هاتفي.

description.en: A message said my account was suspended and one link would restore it. The sender was not a number I have ever had a message from.
description.ar: رسالة تقول إن حسابي موقوف وإن رابطاً واحداً سيعيده. المرسل لم يكن رقماً وصلتني منه رسالة من قبل.
